shell_plugin.suprx, in this folder, is the quick menu plugin of ElevenMPV-A
by GrapheneCt, unchanged from ElevenMPV-A's release v7.10. It is a program
of its own, licensed under the GNU General Public License, version 3: see
shell_plugin.LICENSE.txt, beside it. VitaPlex BG loads it into the system
shell and talks to it through message pipes; VitaPlex itself is licensed
under the Apache License, version 2.0.

Its source:
  - in VitaPlex's repository, https://github.com/breezyslasher/vita_plex,
    folder third_party/elevenmpva-shell-plugin, with where it comes from;
  - and upstream, https://github.com/GrapheneCt/ElevenMPV-A, tag v7.10.
